file_id: M. Karthik vs State Represented By Its Inspector Of ... on 12 November, 2024

sentences.text: M. Karthik vs State Represented By Its Inspector Of ... on 12
November, 2024

Author: Aravind Kumar
Bench: Aravind Kumar
 1
 In The Supreme Court Of India
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Criminal Appeal No.4568 /2024

[@ Slp [Crl.] No.2742/2021]
 M. Karthik Appel
 Versus
 State
 Represented By Its Inspector Of Police Resp
 O R D E R
Leave granted.

Though we are not inclined to go into the merits of the case, upon going through the facts and circumstances of the case, it is a fit case to reduce the sentence imposed, particularly, when the appellant has been acquitted under Section 376, IPC by the High Court.
In such view of the matter, while maintaining the conviction rendered by the High Court under Section 417, IPC in the impugned judgment, the sentence is modified to the one already undergone.
Accordingly, the appeal is allowed in part.

...................J. [M.M. SUNDRESH] ...................J. [ARAVIND KUMAR] NEW DELHI;
NOVEMBER 12, 2024.

KARTHIK Petitioner(s) VERSUS STATE REPRESENTED BY ITS INSPECTOR OF POLICE Respondent(s) IA No. 35363/2021 - EXEMPTION FROM FILING O.T. Date : 12-11-2024

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This petition was called on for hearing today.
CORAM :
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE M.M. SUNDRESH HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ARAVIND KUMAR
For Petitioner(s) Mr. G. Ananda Selvam, Adv.
Mr. Mayilsamy. K, Adv.

Mr. Habib Muzaffer, Adv. Mr. Amar Shankar, Adv.
Ms. Lakshmi Ramamurthy, AOR For Respondent(s) Mr. D.Kumanan, AOR Ms.
Deepa S, Adv.
Mr. Sheikh F Kalia, Adv. Mr. Veshal Tyagi, Adv.

Mr. Chinmay Anand Panigrahi, Adv. Ms. Shagufa Khan, Adv.
UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following O R D E R Leave granted.

The Court inter alia directed as under:
In such view of the matter, while maintaining the conviction rendered by the High Court under Section 417, IPC in the impugned judgment, the sentence is modified to the one already undergone.
The appeal is allowed in part in terms of the signed order.
Pending application(s), if any, shall stand disposed of.
(ASHA SUNDRIYAL) (POONAM VAID) ASTT. REGISTRAR-cum-PS COURT MASTER (NSH)
[Signed order is placed on the file]
